context: M24 o4. Carriers' garage, dispatch booth. Augie grey in the face, coughing, cigar unlit.

lines.speaker: char.augie_lomax
lines.text: Varelas. You come to my garage? You never come to my garage.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: Lisle says you're selling the Association. To him.

lines.speaker: char.augie_lomax
lines.text: I'm sick, Varelas. Doctor gives me a year. Who gets my drivers? A lawyer.

lines.speaker: char.augie_lomax
lines.text: Forty years I fought the old rackets off these streets. Look what I built instead.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: Same as me, Augie. Same as all of us.
